text:
Got it — a red lighthouse standing on that rocky coast, golden hour light going down, nothing else in the frame but the sea and sky. Let me make it.

[Image of a red lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset, waves crashing below, warm orange and pink sky, no people or text]

Here you go—red lighthouse on the rocks, golden hour lighting, no people, nothing written in it.

[Image: A tall red lighthouse stands on a rugged rocky coastline as the sun dips toward the horizon. Warm orange and pink light spills across the water, and waves crash against the dark rocks at the base. The sky is streaked with sunset colors with no people or text anywhere in the scene.]

Here you go — a red lighthouse standing on those jagged rocks, the sun dipping low and painting everything in warm gold.

[Image: A red lighthouse on a rocky coastline at sunset, no people, no text]

I kept it pretty moody — the sky's all oranges and purples, and the light's coming off the water in that way it does right before it's fully dark. Figured that felt more real than something too bright and cheerful. Let me know if you wanted it a little different — more stormy, calmer, whatever vibe you were going for.

Here's your picture:

[Picture of a red lighthouse standing on a rocky coastline, with the sun setting over the ocean, casting warm orange and pink light across the sky and water. No people, no text.]

It turned out lovely — I love how the sunset light pools around the base of the lighthouse and makes the rocks look almost golden. It feels calm and a little lonely in the best way, like that quiet moment right before it gets dark by the sea. Hope that's the mood you were going for!
